title: Axolotl waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#f7a8c4'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='75' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#ffbcd6'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#ffd6e6'/>
  <!-- left arm (resting) -->
  <path d='M28 70 Q20 74 18 82' stroke='#f7a8c4' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- right arm waving -->
  <path d='M72 68 Q82 60 84 48' stroke='#f7a8c4' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- waving hand -->
  <circle cx='85' cy='45' r='6' fill='#ffbcd6'/>
  <!-- fingers -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='39' r='2.5' fill='#ffd6e6'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#ffd6e6'/>
  <circle cx='89' cy='41' r='2.5' fill='#ffd6e6'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='24' ry='19' fill='#f7a8c4'/>
  <!-- gills left -->
  <path d='M28 34 Q16 28 12 34' stroke='#ff8fb8' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M27 40 Q14 38 11 44' stroke='#ff8fb8' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M28 46 Q17 48 14 54' stroke='#ff8fb8' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- gills right -->
  <path d='M72 34 Q84 28 88 34' stroke='#ff8fb8' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M73 40 Q86 38 89 44' stroke='#ff8fb8' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M72 46 Q83 48 86 54' stroke='#ff8fb8' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='4' fill='#3a1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='40' r='4' fill='#3a1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='39' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='39' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='48' r='3.5' fill='#ff8fb8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='48' r='3.5' fill='#ff8fb8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M43 49 Q50 55 57 49' stroke='#c94f82' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M40 90 Q50 96 60 90' stroke='#ff8fb8' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
</svg>
